usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve a pre-rendered RRD graph (returned as a PNG filename path) for a specific node's performance datasources over a chosen timeframe. The caller requires Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}. For raw numeric time-series data instead of a PNG, use the rrddata endpoint.

examples.summary: Fetch a 24-hour average CPU and memory usage graph for node pve1

tips: The response contains a filename path to the PNG on the PVE host, not the image bytes themselves — the file is served separately via the Proxmox web UI.
Common datasource names include cpu, memused, memtotal, netin, netout, roottotal, rootused, swaptotal, swapused — check the rrddata endpoint to discover what is actually recorded for a given node.
Omitting cf defaults to AVERAGE on most PVE versions; specify MAX explicitly when you need peak-usage graphs.
The decade timeframe produces very coarse resolution and is only useful for long-term trend overviews.
